content.text: Cron installed. Now write the health check script:

arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash
# healthcheck.sh — system health check script
# Runs every minute via cron, logs to /var/log/healthcheck.log

LOGFILE="/var/log/healthcheck.log"
TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

# --- Disk usage ---
DISK=$(df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}')
DISK_INT=${DISK%%%}

# --- Memory usage ---
MEM_TOTAL=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $2}')
MEM_USED=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $3}')
MEM_PCT=$(( MEM_USED * 100 / MEM_TOTAL ))

# --- Load average (1 min) ---
LOAD=$(cat /proc/loadavg | awk '{print $1}')

# --- SSH daemon ---
SSH_STATUS=$(pgrep -x sshd > /dev/null && echo "running" || echo "stopped")

# --- Determine overall status ---
STATUS="OK"
WARNINGS=""

if [ "$DISK_INT" -ge 90 ]; then
    STATUS="WARN"
    WARNINGS="${WARNINGS} [disk:${DISK}]"
fi

if [ "$MEM_PCT" -ge 90 ]; then
    STATUS="WARN"
    WARNINGS="${WARNINGS} [mem:${MEM_PCT}%]"
fi

if [ "$SSH_STATUS" = "stopped" ]; then
    STATUS="WARN"
    WARNINGS="${WARNINGS} [sshd:stopped]"
fi

# --- Write log entry ---
echo "${TIMESTAMP} | ${STATUS}${WARNINGS} | disk=${DISK} mem=${MEM_USED}/${MEM_TOTAL}MB(${MEM_PCT}%) load=${LOAD} sshd=${SSH_STATUS}" >> "$LOGFILE"

# --- Rotate log if >1MB ---
if [ $(stat -c%s "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) -gt 1048576 ]; then
    mv "$LOGFILE" "${LOGFILE}.1"
fi
